endorsements.name: Jens Freitag
endorsements.label: The State of Security: Securing today's elastic IT assets
endorsements.description: With increasing threats and a constantly changing IT landscape, it's more challenging than ever to keep up with identifying vulnerabilities and, more importantly, fix them. As organizations embrace public cloud, mobile and DevOps, the fundamental concept of an asset changes, and radically impacts how security teams performs their jobs and interacts with the rest of the organization. This presentation will give you an overview of fresh vulnerability management approaches that give the visibility and insight to protect what matters most.
endorsements.subtitle: Insomni'hack 2017
